title: Music City White House - Nashville Southern Charm
description:
With an upstairs nook stocked with games and two living rooms for socializing, the White House is the perfect place for families or groups. Located on 8th Ave S. just off of I-65, it is a quick drive to the famous Music Row, Midtown, Downtown, SoBro and the Gulch. It is within walking distance to shopping, dining, music and more.

The space
The White House can comfortably accommodate up to 15 people. It has two living rooms, two dining areas (one inside and one outside), four bedrooms, two baths, and a nook with a game table as well as a writing desk/work space. There is a washer and dryer on site and we provide all basic amenities - towels, linens, pillows, paper products, and basic cooking and dining ware. The house is equipped with a keyless entry pad which makes coming and going a breeze. The house has two Smart TV's that are connected to Wifi and one TV that has a DVD player with some movies that can be watch. Feel free to bring your Apple TVs, Gaming systems or what not to use during your stay. We do not provide access to streaming services but you can log into your own during your stay. There are stairs in the house and leading into both the front and back entrance. It is not ADA accessible. The house has parking behind the house that can accommodate up to 4 cars.

Guest access
Guests have access to the entire house excluding the basement and attic spaces. These areas are locked off. There is also a restock closet in the downstairs bathroom that is for the cleaning and maintenance crew that is kept locked and not accessible to guests.
